The '''Randon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. A [[Battle of the Randon system (Great Sith War)|battle]] of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] was fought here. A [[Battle of the Randon system (Mandalorian Wars)|battle]] of the [[Mandalorian Wars]] was as well, in [[3962 BBY]].
